metadata.Name: Rainformer Network
metadata.Author: sGzs-pul53dr1v3r
metadata.Information: Shows you your IP address and network activity.

localVariables.note: Section [Variables] in Network.ini itself. Pulls in @Resources/Variables.inc and @Resources/Styles.inc first, then overrides/adds the following.

colors.note: RGB from @Resources/Variables.inc, Alpha from the matching *Alpha key (looked up because several are referenced in Network.ini but were not all listed in the prompt's resolved summary).

colorInactiveButton.note: used for dimmed arrow icons / graph toggle buttons; not in prompt's resolved list, found in Variables.inc

colors.alternateThemeNote: Variables.inc also defines a parallel 'r'-prefixed color family (rBgTopColor=0,0,0/255, rBgBodyColor=0,0,0/180, rStrokeColor=172,172,172/100, rStroke_Width=1, rcolorText=255,255,255, etc.) presumably an alternate/dark theme swapped in by MeasureSettingsScript (Settings.lua) at runtime. The screenshot/context provided matches the LIGHT (non-r) palette, so the r-family is documented but not used in this resolved spec.

background: Rounded two-tone 'pill' card built entirely from one Meter=Shape (MeterBackground, MeterStyle=StyleBackground), unscaled base coords then uniformly scaled by TransformationMatrix=1.7. Header (Shape/Shape2/Shape3 union) = rounded-top rect from BgOffset*Scale straight down through an unrounded extension, filled BgTopColor@opacity180 (163,178,230,180). Body (Shape4/Shape5/Shape6 union) = rounded-bottom rect starting further down, filled BgBodyColor@opacity180 (230,230,230,180). Shape7 is an outer frame rect with StrokeWidth=Stroke_Width*Scale=0 (i.e. currently invisible, StrokeColor 96,138,203,100 unused at width 0) and transparent fill. Total panel height is driven by MeterBackgroundHeight, an invisible 1px Image meter whose Y is chained (R) below the last content meter (meterHistogramAlign) by BottomMargin+BgOffset+2=10 logical px; StyleBackground's H = [MeterBackgroundHeight:Y]*Scale. See 'backgroundShapeDetail' and 'verticalFlowResolved' for resolved numbers (the latter includes an estimated per-row text height, see caveats).

backgroundShapeDetail.Shape2_headerExtension: Rectangle(8.5, 22.1, 333.2, 23.8)  -- no radius, unioned with Shape to flatten its bottom edge
backgroundShapeDetail.Shape5_bodyExtension: Rectangle(8.5, 49.3, 333.2, 25.5) -- no radius, unioned with Shape4 to flatten its top edge
backgroundShapeDetail.Shape7_outlineFrame: Rectangle(7.65, 7.65, 334.9, ([panelH_scaled]+1.7-17), 7.65) StrokeWidth 0 (=Stroke_Width*Scale, currently invisible) StrokeColor 96,138,203,100, Fill 0,0,0,0

measures.name: measureNetIn

ifConditions.ifAboveAction: [!SetOption meterDLArrow "FontColor" "#colorNetDown#"] -> 51,153,255 (alpha defaults 255 since no alpha component passed)

measures.notes: Current download bytes/sec for the chosen interface. Drives meterDownloadValue, DownloadHistogram, meterDownloadBar, and meterDLArrow's runtime color.

measures.name: measureNetOut
measures.notes: Current upload bytes/sec. Drives meterUploadValue, UploadHistogram, meterUploadBar, meterULArrow color.

measures.name: measureIntIP
measures.onChangeAction: [!Log "Internal IP address changed, refreshing external IP address" Notice][!CommandMeasure measureExtIP "Reset"][!CommandMeasure measureExtIP "Update"][!SetOptionGroup Notifications Reload 0][!UpdateMeasure "MeasureConnected"][!UpdateMeasure "measureExtIP"]
measures.notes: Local/LAN IP address for the interface, e.g. 192.168.1.45 per screenshot. Empty result substituted to 'N/A'. Changing this value forces the external-IP WebParser to reset+re-fetch.

measures.name: measureExtIP
measures.notes: UpdateDivider=-1 means it never auto-refreshes on the normal 1000ms cycle; it is only fetched when explicitly triggered (via measureIntIP's OnChangeAction, or manual !CommandMeasure Update). Result shows as 'N/A' until/unless the fetch resolves (matches screenshot 'N/A' external IP). Commented-out alternative endpoints documented in ini: secure.internode.on.net/webtools/showmyip (RegExp="(.*)"), checkip.dyndns.org (active), ipdetect.dnspark.com (Address:...</body> pattern), icanhazip.com, ipv4.wtfismyip.com/text, api.ipify.org (all three use RegExp="(?siU)^(.*)$").

measures.name: MeasureAdapterName
measures.notes: UpdateDivider line is commented out (;UpdateDivider=-1), so this measure updates every normal 1000ms cycle. Feeds tooltip text for IconLan/IconWLan mouse regions.

measures.name: MeasureAdapterType
measures.notes: OnChangeAction commented out. DynamicVariables=1 appears twice in the ini (harmless duplicate). Feeds MeasureConnected's ethernet(6)/wifi(71) branch.

measures.name: MeasureSSID
measures.notes: Measure itself is disabled in the resolved config (SSID=0), independent from the meter Hidden flags.

measures.name: MeasureSignal
measures.notes: No Disabled key -- unlike MeasureSSID this measure keeps running (default UpdateDivider, every cycle) even though Signal=0 hides its meters; it also feeds MeasureConnected's wlan-signal branch (IfCondition3/4).

measures.name: MeasureInternet
measures.notes: Persists InternetAccess (0/1) to the ini's Variables section via WriteKeyValue, so it survives skin reloads.

measures.name: MeasureConnected
measures.resultMeaning: 0=no network, 1=lan, 2=wlan no signal, 3=wlan, 4=unknown network (per ini comment; note formula's own range is 0-3, the '4=unknown' state is reached via IfCondition5 below when MeasureConnected=3)
measures.onChangeAction: [!RefreshGroup "NETWORK"]  (an alternate lighter-weight OnChangeAction using UpdateMeterGroup/UpdateMeasureGroup+Redraw is present but commented out)
measures.notes: NetworkStatus (0..4) selects which of the 5 IconXxx_/IconXxx meter pairs is shown (see meters). Resolved config: NetworkStatus=1 -> LAN/ethernet icon shown, all other status icons hidden.

measures.name: MeasureMaxBytesPerSecDS
measures.notes: Session download-speed peak/high-water-mark. Each cycle: candidate = max(current NetIn value, stored MaxDSBytesPerSec). If candidate is both a new high AND below the sanity cap 134217728 bytes/s (=128 MiB/s, guards against bogus driver spike readings), !SetVariable writes the candidate into MaxDSBytesPerSec in-memory (NOT persisted to disk via WriteKeyValue, so the peak resets to 0 on skin reload, only surviving for the running session -- MaxDSBytesPerSec=0 is the seed value in [Variables]). This is the mechanism behind the '56.8 MB/s' peak reading in the screenshot.

measures.name: MeasureMaxBytesPerSecUS
measures.notes: Mirror of MeasureMaxBytesPerSecDS for upload; matches screenshot '60.3 MB/s' peak.

measures.name: measureNetInTotal
measures.notes: Cumulative=1 makes the built-in NetIn plugin accumulate total bytes received since Rainmeter/session start (or since the last !ResetStats, wired to meterResetClickableRegion's LeftMouseUpAction). Matches screenshot '158.1 GB' session download total.

measures.name: measureNetOutTotal
measures.notes: Matches screenshot '56.5 GB' session upload total.

measures.notes: Provides Lua GetKey()/Gsub() helpers used by StyleStringButtonHover/StyleMouseRegionStringButtonHover (in Styles.inc) to read a meter's current FontColor and append/strip the hover alpha on mouse enter/leave.

verticalFlowSummary: Header row (icons, title, hide/show-graph buttons, reset/gear buttons) all use ABSOLUTE Y values anchored to #BgOffset# (5), independent of each other: title Y=9, status icons Y=4..10 depending on which one, hide/show-graph buttons Y=4. The main content column starts at the first fully-absolute anchor Y=#TopMarginFormula#=32 (meterExtIPLabel/Value row). Every subsequent content row chains off the previous one via Rainmeter's relative Y syntax: 'nR' = previous meter's Y+H (bottom) + n, 'nr'/'r' = previous meter's Y (not bottom) + n. Each optional row (InternalIP/SSID/Signal/NetSpeed/NetSpeedPeak/NetTotal) uses a ternary 'n:0' trick on the R-offset so a disabled row contributes 0 extra gap -- but per Rainmeter's documented behavior, a Hidden=1 meter's own H is still added into the chain for whatever meter comes after it (hidden meters are not removed from relative-position bookkeeping), so disabled rows are not fully zero-height, only their inter-row gap is. In the resolved config (SSID=0, Signal=0 hidden; InternalIP/ExternalIP/NetSpeed/NetSpeedPeak/NetTotal/ShowGraph=1 shown) the chain is: ExtIP(Y=32) -> IntIP(Y=32+H_ext+1) -> SSID row(hidden, +0) -> Signal label/bar/percent(hidden, +0/+7r/copy) -> Download/Speed/Upload(+1) -> Peak DS/PEAK/Peak US(+1) -> Total DL/SUM/Total UL(+1) -> DownloadHistogram/UploadHistogram graphs(+1, H=25 explicit) -> arrows(graph Y-3, H=14 explicit) -> meterHistogramAlign(copy of graph Y, H=25 explicit) -> MeterBackgroundHeight(+10) which feeds StyleBackground's total panel H. See 'verticalFlowResolved' for the concrete estimated numbers.

verticalFlowResolved.caveat: Only rows with an EXPLICIT H in the ini/Styles.inc (bars, line-graphs, arrow icons, the invisible Image anchors) have certain heights. All plain STRING/TEXT rows here (ExtIP, IntIP, SSID, Signal label/percent, Download/Speed/Upload, Peak DS/PEAK/Peak US, Total DL/SUM/Total UL) have NO explicit H -- Rainmeter auto-computes it from actual GDI+/DirectWrite font metrics for Trebuchet MS at the given size/weight, which cannot be derived from the ini text alone. The estimates below assume a per-row text height of 11 logical (unscaled) px, inferred from a sibling style in the same Styles.inc (styleSecondaryText2, unused in this file but same FontFamily/textSize=8, explicitly hardcodes H=11). Treat every 'estimatedValue'/estimated:true field throughout this document as APPROXIMATE -- when implementing in Direct2D/DirectWrite, measure the actual line height for 'Trebuchet MS' Bold/Regular at 8pt and 7pt and recompute this chain exactly; do not hardcode these estimates as ground truth.

meterHistogramAlign.certainty: y estimated (copy of graph y), h exact

notes: Font: FontFamily=Trebuchet MS everywhere except icon glyphs (Segoe MDL2 Assets for status icons, ElegantIcons for arrow/gear/reset glyphs). Base textSize=8 (7 for the small SPEED/PEAK/SUM flourish labels, 9 for the title, 12 for arrows/status icons, 16 for the unknown-network icon).

TransformationMatrix=#Scale#;0;0;#Scale#;#Scale#;#Scale# (i.e. Scale;0;0;Scale;Scale;Scale = 1.7;0;0;1.7;1.7;1.7) is applied on most meters: a uniform 1.7x scale about the origin plus a (Scale,Scale)=(1.7,1.7) translation. All X/Y/W/H math in the ini is done in unscaled 'logical' units; final on-screen geometry = logical_value*1.7, with an added +1.7 offset baked into the matrix's Dx/Dy. StyleBackground is the one meter that manually pre-multiplies its own Shape coordinates by #Scale# instead of relying purely on TransformationMatrix, because it needs Scale baked into Shape/Shape2/etc. path coordinates for the rounded-rect union tricks to align.

NetIn/NetOut AutoScale nuance: GraphAutoscale=0 (global var) is passed as the Line/Bar meters' own AutoScale option, which controls whether the GRAPH rescales its vertical range to the recently-seen max. Since no MaxValue is set on measureNetIn/measureNetOut, Rainmeter's built-in NetIn/NetOut measure plugin has its own internal dynamic-max behavior for percentage/graph scaling (separate from the meter-level AutoScale flag and separate from this skin's own custom MeasureMaxBytesPerSecDS/US peak-tracking Calc measures). Implementers should verify actual Rainmeter NetIn/NetOut scaling behavior (based on measured historical max, reset by !ResetStats) if trying to match the graph's vertical scale exactly, rather than assuming a fixed byte/sec-to-pixel ratio.

Peak mechanism (download/upload): MeasureMaxBytesPerSecDS/US are Calc measures that each cycle compute max(currentSpeed, storedPeakVariable), and if the new value is both higher than the old stored peak AND below a 134217728 bytes/s (128 MiB/s) sanity ceiling, write it back into #MaxDSBytesPerSec#/#MaxUSBytesPerSec# via !SetVariable. This uses !SetVariable only (no WriteKeyValue), so the peak is a SESSION high-water-mark that resets to the ini's seed value (0) on skin reload/refresh -- it is NOT the all-time peak across reboots.

Total/session mechanism: measureNetInTotal/measureNetOutTotal are ordinary NetIn/NetOut measures with Cumulative=1, which is Rainmeter's built-in running total of bytes transferred since Rainmeter started (or since the last !ResetStats). meterResetClickableRegion's LeftMouseUpAction=[!ResetStats][!Refresh] is the only way to zero these in-skin.

Interface=Best (global var) is passed as SysInfoData/Interface to essentially every measure (measureNetIn/Out, measureIntIP, MeasureAdapterName/Type, MeasureInternet, MeasureLANConnection, the Total measures) so they all track whichever network interface Rainmeter's 'Best' auto-detection currently considers primary; WiFi-specific measures (SSID/Signal/Encryption/Auth/Bands) instead hardcode WifiIntfID=0 (first wireless adapter) independent of 'Best'.

NetworkStatus (0-4) state machine (computed once per change by MeasureConnected's Calc formula, persisted via WriteKeyValue) selects exactly one of 5 status icon pairs to display: 0=IconNoNetwork(_), 1=IconLan(_) [resolved/active], 2=IconNoSignal(_), 3=IconWlan(_), 4=IconUnknownNetwork(_). Each also has a same-named invisible mouse-region meter (no trailing underscore) providing hover tooltip text.
InternetAccess (0/1) independently controls only the small IconNoInternet_/IconNoInternet badge overlay (shown when InternetAccess=0); resolved InternetAccess=1 so it is hidden.

ShowGraph (0/1) toggles the entire graphs row (DownloadHistogram, meterDownloadBar, UploadHistogram, meterUploadBar, meterDLArrow, meterULArrow, meterHistogramAlign -- Group=GraphsMeter) plus swaps which of meterHideGraphs_/meterShowGraphs_ (and their matching invisible click-catchers meterHideGraphs/meterShowGraphs) is visible; toggling persists to disk via WriteKeyValue and forces the Background group to re-measure (shrinking/growing the panel height since MeterBackgroundHeight's Y depends on whether the graph row's meters are present in the chain).

Two apparent bugs/inconsistencies preserved verbatim from the source: (1) meterintIPMouseRegion (and its X/Y/W/H/tooltip formulas) references '[meterintIPLabel:...]', '[meterintIPValue:...]' and '[measureintIP]' all lowercase, which do not exactly match the actual defined section names 'meterIntIPLabel'/'meterIntIPValue'/'measureIntIP' (capital I) -- Rainmeter section-name lookups in variable/measure references are typically case-sensitive, so this region's geometry/tooltip may silently fail to resolve; (2) meterIntIPValue's UpdateDivider gates on '#ExternalIP#' rather than '#InternalIP#', likely a copy-paste artifact.

Colors are all expressed as separate 'colorX' (RGB) + 'colorXAlpha' (0-255) variable pairs in Variables.inc and recombined in the ini as '#colorX#,#colorXAlpha#'; a handful of meters (e.g. IconNoNetwork_, meterHideGraphs_) instead hardcode a plain 3-tuple RGB with no alpha variable, which Rainmeter treats as fully opaque (alpha=255).

ExtIP/IntIP row Y anchor formula '((#ExternalIP#=1)?#TopMarginFormula#:(#TopMarginFormula#-1))' means: if the external-IP row itself is going to be shown, content starts at TopMarginFormula(32); if external IP were disabled, content would start 1px higher (31) since there'd be no ExtIP row taking the very first slot for InternalIP to chain off of relative-positioning-wise -- in the resolved config (ExternalIP=1) this nuance doesn't apply.
